# R3 — a claim carries its scope
# A figure `D<n> = k on N of M cards` is read at the scope ITS OWN WORDS carry
# and re-derived against the cards on disk. Nothing here gates the product.
# FORM P (SS-04) also reads `<n> of <m>` in ORDINARY PROSE, and can return
# neither REFUTED nor HOLDS: UNREACHABLE is its default and COUNT-MOVED its
# only other answer. A claim it cannot reach is NOT a claim that holds.
